decision: rules are an ordered table Rule[] with regex fields over a Subject (category, family, typeName, typeKey, Function, hostCategory); massing and parapet rows precede Function = Exterior
why: first match wins deletes the if chain and makes the 70 Generic - Massing walls (Function Exterior) land as massing, which the brief says would wreck WWR otherwise
evidence: lib/classify/rules.ts RULES; lib/classify/rules.test.ts 24 type rows plus 2 leftovers

decision: envelope categories with no matching rule stay leftovers (null); only non-envelope categories settle as other by rule
why: a basic wall with no Function is exactly the case the decision model and the person must see; silently calling it other would hide facade area
evidence: NOT_ENVELOPE negative lookahead in rules.ts; index.test.ts leftovers = Generic - 200mm and Cornice

decision: decisions go through plain fetch to https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/evaluate, not the ai SDK and not /v1/decisions
why: ai is not a dependency and one POST needs none; /v1/evaluate is the native endpoint per vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/modalities/decision.md while /v1/decisions is the OpenAI-compatible shape; the gateway fallback object (confidenceBelow 0.6 to openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions) rides in providerOptions.gateway.models
evidence: lib/classify/decide.ts; decide.test.ts asserts the body; scripts/verify/unit3-decide.mjs measured 604 ms, jev 1.000 on System Panel / Glazed, luna fallback 0.700 interior-wall on Generic - 200mm and 0.990 other on Cornice

decision: merge order in classifySnapshot: user prior, then rule, then model prior with confidence above 0, else leftover; model answers never override a rule
why: a person's confirmation is the audit trail; a model answer is cheaper than a rule to be wrong about, so it only fills gaps
evidence: lib/classify/index.ts; index.test.ts user prior wins and model prior does not override window

decision: pack is a manifest-driven table: PackManifest.documents one row per measure PDF plus manifest, CSV and elevation PNGs; file names documentFileName(measure, version, ext) = <Measure>_<Title>-<NN>.<ext>; MEASURE_TITLES registry in lib/export/manifest.ts
why: Part 8 versioned naming and the audit-trail cross-reference (parameter, value, unit, file, page) fall out of one table instead of per-measure branches; manifest.parameters carries that shape
evidence: lib/export/manifest.ts, lib/export/export.test.ts

decision: CSV is two header-led blocks: design inputs then eight EEM01 rows N..NW with wall_area_m2, glazing_area_m2, wwr_percent to 2 decimals, guide part and page per row; an orientation without a facade writes 0.00 never blank; a run with no EEM01 measure still writes eight zero rows
why: Part 3 says blank orientations fall back to defaults and direct entries are not accepted, so the file mirrors the calculator rows
evidence: lib/export/csv.ts; test EEM01 block has exactly eight orientation rows

decision: PDF via pdf-lib standard Helvetica, A4, entered values on a light yellow fill, title, project, model, URN, viewable, guide part and page, date, author, app version table, one elevation per extra page, disclaimer footer; text outside WinAnsi becomes a question mark
why: standard fonts avoid font embedding in the browser; the auditor rule asks for highlighted entered values and date, title, author on every document
evidence: scratchpad/shots/unit6-eem01-page1.png, unit6-eem09-page1.png; pdfinfo pages = 1 + elevations
